sloka: सकामो भव सुग्रीव रुमाम् त्वम् प्रतिपत्स्यसे ।भुंक्ष्व राज्यम् अनुद्विग्नः शस्तो भ्राता रिपुः तव ॥४-२०-२१॥
transliteration: sakāmo bhava sugrīva rumām tvam pratipatsyase ।bhuṁkṣva rājyam anudvignaḥ śasto bhrātā ripuḥ tava ॥4-20-21॥

translations.english: '(To Vali she said) O lord of monkeys Why don't you speak to me loving words when I am wailing this way? Here are your excellent wives'
